sections.title: Web Helpers
sections.description: Shared helpers for views and templates.
sections.content: The web helpers module defines common functions for rendering HTML, formatting data, and generating links. These helpers are used across LiveViews and templates.
sections.code:
defmodule DashboardWeb do
  def view do
    quote do
      use Phoenix.View
      import DashboardWeb.Helpers
    end
  end
end
